name: Lightning AOE
description: A storm bolt hammers a 7 m circle: runes charge, bolts rain around the ring, the main strike lifts a field of hovering rock and the ground burns with branching electric veins before everything falls.

metadata.reference: Lightning Area of Effect concept sheet: 1 cast 0-0.3 (runes form, energy gathers), 2 build 0.3-0.6 (lightning descends), 3 impact 0.6-1.0 (main bolt hits, debris lifts), 4 sustain 1.0-2.0 (arcs spread, continuous damage), 5 fade 2.0-3.0 (energy disperses, debris falls)
metadata.analysis: The ground web of branching arcs is the hero read: two animated vein decals carry the density, 26 blinking beam nodes put live 3D arcs on top of them. Rocks hang on a keyframed buoyancy force that releases at 2.0 s. A procedural disc volume was tried for the ground haze and dropped: it cost about 10 fps in the GPU viewer for a read the lit smoke sprites already give.
